headline: Le Grand-Espace Sherbrooke: A New Cultural Venue / Atelier Paul Laurendeau + NEUF architect(e)s
context: Le Grand-Espace enhances the cultural offering of the Eastern Townships tourist region through a flexible performance venue capable of hosting a wide range of artistic disciplines, from theatre and dance to circus arts and productions for young audiences.
